headline: chip stocks gave back much of Monday's huge Nvidia-led rally, while reports said the White House is preparing sweeping new tariffs on China and dozens of other countries
points: Chip stocks gave back much of Monday's big Nvidia-led rally, which pulled the Nasdaq down while the Dow rose, so it was a mixed session
The Wall Street Journal reported that the White House is preparing broad new tariffs on China, the EU, Japan, South Korea and dozens of other countries, with details possibly announced this week
Final tariff rates have not been announced
The S&P 500 finished down about 0.5 percent, the Nasdaq fell about 1.5 percent, and the Dow rose about 0.8 percent
Wednesday brings the PCE inflation report and a Fed Beige Book, then US markets close on Thursday for Thanksgiving

vixCall.text: Today V I X jumped more than 10 percent at one point, but it came back to finish roughly flat, so my call is a tick: the fear spike has peaked. But V I X is still in the high twenties, which is on the high side, so we may need to revisit this one tomorrow.
